name: Mintra Holding AS
summary: Mintra Holding AS provides workforce management systems worldwide. It delivers services covering human resources (HR), competence management, and training to customers in various business environments. The company offers OCS HR, a suite of software covering HR, crewing, and payroll needs of shipping and offshore companies; OCS HR Self-Service solution that connects employees directly to the HR-system; OCS HR Payroll, which enables payroll processes and handles various currencies and payrolls; OCS HR Crew On Board, a tool that enables HR management needs; and TRAININGPORTAL, a cloud-based system that enables delivery, management, and reporting of remote workforce training. It also provides bespoke training courses; payroll outsourcing services; crew rotation; and learning, travel, and talent management. In addition, the company offers online courses for maritime, and oil and gas industries. Mintra Holding AS was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Bergen, Norway.
